reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's Shell-Neck, Slim, and Grim; the frame is stated correctly: Constance tells it to Sprawl inside The Plover Who Fought the Ocean, which Victor tells Lively.
The plot follows Ryder: the twelve-year drought, the plea, the stick, the vow of silence, the town's talk of a 'cart' in the sky and the fatal reply.

Age band 12+: a sympathetic character dies, told in one calm sentence; the townspeople cutting up the turtle is omitted and disclosed in the changes and the content note. Additions (the turtle's love of talk, the geese's grief, the second half of the moral) are disclosed.

After review the turtle now explains the stick plan before biting the stick, so it never speaks with the stick in its mouth, and the three animals are referred to in the neuter (ಮೂರೂ). The pause question comes before the turtle speaks; no em dashes.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; seams measured at x=512 and y=512/1024; painted edge to edge with no gutters or text.

The same two bar-headed geese and the same turtle appear throughout, with the stick consistent from panel 3: chatting by the full lake, pleading by the last puddle on cracked mud, the stick plan, the flight over fields and river, and the villagers pointing.
The fall and death are not drawn: panel 6 shows only the two geese at sunset with an empty stick.
Villagers wear everyday clothes with similar natural skin tones; no sacred thread, tilak or tuft, and no modern objects.

Credit line verified against the Codex logs: gpt-6.1-sol was refused for this account and the single generation used gpt-5.6-sol. Accepted minor issue: in panels 4 and 5 the stick seems to pass behind the second goose's body.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children or parents.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.

Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol because gpt-6.1-sol is not available to this ChatGPT-linked account; it was judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
